title: Publish current draft to production

requirements.text: Publish the currently deployed draft application (Draft Version 21) to production so the production URL serves the same build as the draft.
acceptanceCriteria: The production deployment is updated to match Draft Version 21.
Users visiting the production URL see the same behavior/features as in the draft review environment.
No additional code changes are required unless publishing fails due to a detected build/deploy issue (in which case the failure reason is reported).

nonGoals: Adding new features or UI changes unrelated to publishing.
Refactoring backend/frontend code when not required to complete the publish.
